title: Standalone APIs

narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: One working curl per service, a chaining shell script for full CSV→RDF pipeline, upload endpoint for private data.
steps: CSVToCSVW — annotate CSV from URL, diff against pre-computed result, upload endpoint for private data
MapToMethod — types and entities exploration, generate YARRRML mapping
RDFConverter — validate (checkmapping), convert (createrdf) with inline JSON response
Full pipeline shell script — CSV→CSVW→validate→RDF using real IOFMaterialsTutorial data
Other real working examples table — IOFMaterialsTutorial + BAMresearch DF-TEM-PAW

quality_gate: One curl example per service (CSVToCSVW, MapToMethod, RDFConverter)
Upload endpoint for private data documented (annotate_upload)
num_mappings_applied and num_mappings_skipped visible in createrdf response
notes: Page is fully authored. All curl commands use real IOFMaterialsTutorial URLs and are reproducible. RDFConverter response shows correct field names (num_mappings_applied, num_mappings_skipped, graph). No issues found in prior session.

primary.name: Domain Scientist
knows: Their scientific domain deeply (materials science, microscopy, lab procedures)
Measurement concepts and experimental workflows they consider universal
Domain-specific tools (OMERO, ELN systems, instrument software)
does_not_know: Ontology terms like PMDCO, CHAMEO, EMMO even if these describe their own work
How ontologies model domain concepts — that this modeling discipline exists at all
SPARQL, RDF, or any semantic technology
primary.goal: Upload their data, trigger the pipeline, and use or export FAIR-compliant results.
primary.key_gap: Double gap: (1) no semantic web knowledge whatsoever, and (2) domain experts frequently assume their concepts are universal common knowledge when they are not — documentation must not assume shared domain vocabulary and must explain what gets modeled and why, not just how.

secondary.name: Data Engineer
secondary.goal: Connect data sources, author mappings, and query transformation results.
